simple.meaning: אֵלוֹנִי (ʼÊlôwnîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵלוֹנִי (H440) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֵלוֹנִי (H440) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֵלוֹנִי (ʼÊlôwnîy) / H440 is traced through Numbers 26:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
